location_fine: bare dark interrogation hall / soviet-era commission room
character_types: men in retro suits summoned one by one
visual_synopsis: Shot in a sepia, film-noir grade, the whole sketch plays in one bare dark hall styled as a Soviet-era interrogation or commission room: two officials sit behind a lamp-lit desk with microphones while men in retro pinstripe suits wait on a row of wooden chairs and are called in one at a time, each filmed in the same profile close-up against a diagonal shaft of light. Inserts show a hand picking up an electric hair clipper, and at the end a bespectacled man staggers out with a bloodied, scratched face and wrecked hair.
